reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getBulkBudgetCategories and its income rule from shouldSkipIncomeCategory, the same pair the other month-wide actions use, and reads spending through getSheetValue.

duplication.why: Only the loop shape and the expense sign flip mirror set3MonthAvg/setNMonthAvg, where the tree has no shared helper for the flip either.

placement.why: The action is in budget/actions.ts next to its siblings and registered in app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like them.

scope.why: Action, handler type and registration, and tests only.

maintainability.why: Small and aligned with the shared selection; the per-action sign flip is a third inline copy a maintainer might want factored out.
